Our Mission

Empowering Youth Holistically to Be Changemakers

Greenwave Society is a Kenyan non-profit organization that empowers young people to conserve the environment and become agents of sustainable change in their communities. We believe that when youth are equipped with the right tools, knowledge, and opportunities, they can transform the world around them.

Through environmental conservation programs, community outreach, education, and youth empowerment initiatives, we create a ripple effect of positive impact that extends far beyond individual participants.

Explore Our Programs

Environmental Conservation

Protecting and restoring ecosystems through tree planting, waste management, and conservation education.

Youth Empowerment

Building the capacity of young people with skills, knowledge, and opportunities to lead change in their communities.

Community Impact

Creating lasting, positive change through collaborative partnerships and grassroots engagement.

Global Goals

Contributing to the UN Sustainable Development Goals through local, action-oriented programs.

What We Do

Our Programs & Initiatives

We run a range of programs designed to empower youth and protect the environment, creating a sustainable future for communities across Kenya.

Environmental Education

We deliver hands-on workshops and training sessions that teach young people about ecology, sustainability, waste management, and climate science. Our education programs equip the next generation with knowledge to make informed environmental decisions.

WorkshopsSchool ProgramsClimate Literacy

Conservation & Restoration

From tree-planting campaigns to river clean-ups and habitat restoration, our conservation programs directly protect and restore local ecosystems. We mobilize volunteers and partner with communities to conserve natural resources.

Tree PlantingClean-upsHabitat Restoration

Youth Empowerment

We build leadership capacity through mentorship, skills training, and community engagement opportunities. Our programs help youth develop confidence, critical thinking, and project management skills.

LeadershipMentorshipSkills Building

Sustainable Agriculture

We promote sustainable farming practices through community gardens, urban agriculture initiatives, and training on organic farming techniques. These programs enhance food security while protecting the environment.

Urban FarmingFood SecurityOrganic Methods

Recent Activities

What We Have Been Up To

From community clean-ups to leadership summits, our recent activities showcase the breadth of our impact.

ConservationMar 2025

Community Tree-Planting Drive

Mobilized over 100 volunteers for a massive tree-planting event across 3 communities, planting 2,000+ indigenous trees.

EmpowermentJan 2025

Youth Leadership Summit

Hosted a 2-day summit bringing together young changemakers from across Kenya to share ideas and build leadership skills.

EducationNov 2024

Environmental Education Workshop

Delivered interactive workshops on climate change, waste management, and sustainable living to over 200 students.

ConservationSep 2024

River Clean-Up Campaign

Led a community clean-up along local waterways, removing over 1 ton of plastic waste and restoring natural habitats.
